$comment: RTT Intent sub-schema — refreshed 2026-05-06 to add module metadata and session context.
title: RTT Intent Block (v1)
description: Defines the minimal intent substrate for RTTcode packets, capturing directional influence and desired micro-state adjustments. Intent expresses what an agent wants to happen — it does not prescribe behavior, consistent with D369's non-claim NC-5.

_version_history.note: Metadata refresh — added _meta, _session_context, _version_history. No property changes.

target.description: The entity or subsystem the intent is directed toward. Must match an entity id within the same RTTcode packet.

direction.description: Desired directional influence on the target. 'stabilize' resists drift; 'invert' reverses current trajectory.

magnitude.description: Strength of the intended influence. Scale is relative to the environment's boundary range.
